title: Korean-Style Beef Jeon
description: A crispy, savory Korean-style pancake filled with juicy beef. Serve as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: beef (thinly sliced)
ingredients.notes: Optional: marinate beef in 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, and 1 tablespoon garlic for 30 minutes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt. Add eggs and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add water, green onions, grated ginger, and gochujang to the batter and mix until combined.
Add the sliced beef to the batter and mix until coated.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the beef and batter mixture onto the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the jeon and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
